bio: I'm a <primary>Security Engineer</primary> with a backend engineer's foundation - 6 years building the kind of production systems I now focus on securing. Most of my work lives where secure coding meets real applications: authentication, access control, and encryption built into systems that handle sensitive data.

That backend depth is the point. As a <secondary>Backend Developer</secondary> I've shipped microservices and REST APIs at scale, optimized databases, and owned the full path from design to deployment - so I don't just flag vulnerabilities, I understand systems well enough to fix them.

I specialize in application security, authentication and access control, secure API design, and hardening systems against the OWASP Top 10. I'm going deeper on the security side every day, currently building a SIEM and file integrity monitoring tool from scratch.
